fields.title: MycoTelemetry — Environmental Sensing
fields.summary: A room-level sensor network collecting temperature, humidity, CO2, and substrate moisture to maintain optimal mushroom growth microclimates.

fields.title: YieldPredict — Forecasting
fields.summary: Statistical and ML models that predict harvest yields from environmental and substrate features, reducing batch variance.

fields.title: AutoMist — Mist Control System
fields.summary: Automated misting and airflow control with fail-safe cycles and edge analytics for humidity stability.

fields.title: SpawnPrep — SOP Automation
fields.summary: Workflow tooling to standardize spawn preparation, sterilization tracking, and inoculation logging for reproducible batches.

fields.title: RoomSim — Digital Twin
fields.summary: Digital twin of production rooms for scenario testing and environmental optimization without risking live cultures.

fields.title: MycoVision — Imaging Pipeline
fields.summary: Time-lapse imaging and simple CV metrics for pinset detection, growth stage classification, and automated logging.

fields.title: TraceMyco — Batch Traceability
fields.summary: Lightweight provenance store for substrate, spawn, and room conditions tied to batch IDs for compliance.

fields.title: BioSafety Monitor
fields.summary: Alerting layer monitoring contamination markers and environmental excursions, integrated with Slack/email alerts.

fields.title: HarvestPlanner — Scheduler
fields.summary: Scheduling and resource planning for sequential harvests, minimizing downtime between flushes.

fields.title: MycoLab — LIMS-lite
fields.summary: Light laboratory information management features tuned for small-scale mushroom R&D workflows.

fields.title: HumidityMesh — Low-cost Nodes
fields.summary: Design and firmware for low-cost sensor nodes with LoRa and mesh fallback for large facilities.

fields.title: SubstrateDB — Recipe Store
fields.summary: Versioned substrate recipes with yield records and notes to support reproducible experiments.

fields.title: SterileOps — Checklist App
fields.summary: Mobile-friendly checklist app to guide sterile technique during inoculation and substrate handling.

fields.title: ClimateCharts — Monitoring UI
fields.summary: Visual analytics dashboard showing room-level heatmaps and historical climate trends for operators.

fields.title: ScaleGuide — SOPs for Scale
fields.summary: Operational playbook and automation patterns for taking a pilot grow into commercial scale.
